Garage description
This is one of two paints specifically designed for ground operations in a mid-latitude climate. According to reports from the independent organization "True Camouflage", a tank wearing this particular combination of yellow, green and brown, are less likely to be detected in such regions.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Legacy paint description:
A paint that offers decent protection against Smoky. Good for mid-range battles. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
